notes.title: 🔧 BloodyGore Patch 1.0 is Live!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
We just pushed a small update to Battlement to address a few issues and make some minor improvements. We also added a new feature we would like to call: "The BloodyGore Update"

🩸 Update Features:
[list]
[*] Dynamic blood spread in arenas
[*] Droppable meat chunks
[*] Special events that trigger with accumulating blood
[/list]
Before/Beginning of Battle:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618527/e1bc766d9a99a4b13e6c96734c9b3063deebe2fd.png[/img]

After/End of Battle:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618527/79f0f54d5b56d07163f1a36cce24e4d8acacfd3f.png[/img]

📝 Patch Notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed an animation bug in "WaterQueen"
[*] Fixed some wrong translations
[/list]

📢 Note:
If you're experiencing any issues, please restart Steam to ensure the update downloads properly. You can also report bugs or give feedback in the [url=https://t.co/7QiD97AwtE]discord[/url].

Thanks for your continued support!
– Henkdg
